sourceCaveatNotes.title: 2014. III этап. Теоретический тур. 9 класс — инструкции
sourceCaveatNotes.statement:
УТВЕРЖДАЮ. Заместитель председателя оргкомитета заключительного этапа Республиканской олимпиады Заместитель Министра образования. ____________________В.А. Будкевич. «__» декабря 2013 г.

Республиканская физическая олимпиада 2014 год. (III этап). Теоретический тур.

1. Полный комплект состоит из трех заданий.

2. При оформлении работы каждую задачу начинайте с новой страницы. Первая половина тетради предназначена для чистовика, вторая - для черновика. При недостатке бумаги обращайтесь к оргкомитету!

3. Подписывать тетради и отдельные страницы запрещается.

4. В ходе работы можете использовать ручки, карандаши, чертежные принадлежности, калькулятор.

5. Со всеми вопросами, связанными с условиями задач (но не с их решениями), обращайтесь к представителям Жюри.

Постарайтесь внимательно прочитать условия задач! Может вам покажется, что условия задач слишком длинные. Но мы сочинили их такими, чтобы Вам было легче решать. Поверьте, иногда решения короче таких условий! Не теряйте присутствия духа, смело беритесь за решение каждой задачи. Помните, оцениваются не только полные решения, но и их отдельные части и даже отдельные здравые мысли.

Успехов Вам на олимпиаде! Ждем Вас в Могилеве на Заключительном туре!

sourceCaveatNotes.title: Reader note 2: retained native source wording and scope
sourceCaveatNotes.statement: Covers on original question pages 1, 5 and 11 repeat full instructions and the December 2013 approval heading for the 2014 event. Question page 10 contains shared grade 10 reference data. No separate answer forms, marking matrix or author credits occur in the obtainable theory pair.

sourceCaveatNotes.title: Reader note 3: retained native source wording and scope
sourceCaveatNotes.statement: The grade 9 traffic key literally prints x₂ greater than 4388 m or below 4614 m, then 4.4 km or 4.6 km. These final bounds do not follow its preceding inequality. The original displayed expressions are retained.

sourceCaveatNotes.title: Reader note 4: retained native source wording and scope
sourceCaveatNotes.statement: The grade 9 scale key drops a factor of one half between its moment equation and final mass bound. It prints pressure-force results with the unit Pa and omits the added weight in its last numerical substitution. All original expressions and units remain unchanged.

sourceCaveatNotes.title: Reader note 5: retained native source wording and scope
sourceCaveatNotes.statement: The botanical question prints capillary diameter 10⁻⁵ mm; its key uses metres. The question gives salt 20 g/L; the key’s repeated stem gives 1 g/L while its calculation uses 20. Chlorine is labelled M_Na in both stems. These original differences remain.

sourceCaveatNotes.title: Reader note 6: retained native source wording and scope
sourceCaveatNotes.statement: The shared reference page prints Avogadro’s constant as 6.02 mol⁻¹ without a power of ten. Its atmospheric pressure 10⁵ Pa differs from the ice task’s 101 kPa. Both original values remain.

sourceCaveatNotes.title: Reader note 7: retained native source wording and scope
sourceCaveatNotes.statement: The meteorological key repeats equation number 4 and prints heat 1.7 × 10¹⁴ J and about 4 × 10⁴ Gcal. The printed expressions are retained without a substituted arithmetic correction.

sourceCaveatNotes.title: Reader note 8: retained native source wording and scope
sourceCaveatNotes.statement: The elastic disk key’s equation 8 drops a factor of two from the preceding horizontal-speed denominator. The source also switches some body names. All original wording and formulas remain.

sourceCaveatNotes.title: Reader note 9: retained native source wording and scope
sourceCaveatNotes.statement: The ice question switches between Fedya and Vasily. Its key calls the initial expansion compression. Original key page 12 prints 8.6 J / 0.50 m = 17.2 N although page 11 gives work 10.45 J. A direct native PDF detail confirms the decimal 8.6.

sourceCaveatNotes.title: Reader note 10: retained native source wording and scope
sourceCaveatNotes.statement: The ice key’s final total-work substitution on page 14 literally uses 393 K minus 373 K instead of the earlier 293 K and 273 K. The original numerical expression remains unchanged.

sourceCaveatNotes.title: Reader note 11: retained native source wording and scope
sourceCaveatNotes.statement: The burning-ring key explicitly includes parts from an earlier question version. Its labels 1.1–1.7 differ from the current preparation and mechanics labels. All extended material is retained with correspondence notes. Current burning time and flame trajectory have no explicit matching answers; requested angular graphs are absent. Native equation 11 is physically obscured by its overlaid graph. Figure 4 and Figure 10 captions are displaced in the original.

sourceCaveatNotes.title: Reader note 12: retained native source wording and scope
sourceCaveatNotes.statement: The burning-ring key’s printed angle denominator has a plus sign, and its subsequent derivative and angular-speed labels are retained literally. Its field graph covers angles zero to pi while the question considers a full burn to two pi.
